presentation.speaker: landlord
presentation.title: Café health inspection
lines: An inspector is coming within a day. Waste, stockouts, recent ratings and cleaning affect the outcome. Prepare now or accept the current condition. Ignoring the notice does not stop the inspection.

choices.label: Clean for fifteen minutes, then inspect
choices.outcome: The inspector checks the cleaned shop; stock and past service still matter.

choices.label: Inspect the current shop without preparation
choices.outcome: The current condition determines pass, improvement closure or a fine.
